'''Jürgen Reinhard Gerhard Herzog''' ({{IPA|de|ˈjʏʁɡn̩ ˈhɛʁtsoːk|lang}}; 21 December 1941 – 23 April 2024) was an Emeritus Professor of Mathematics at [[University of Duisburg-Essen]], in [[Essen]], Germany.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jürgen Herzog |url=https://www.uni-due.de/mathematik/herzog/ |website=Faculty of Mathematics |publisher=University of Duisburg-Essen |accessdate=20 December 2019}}</ref> From 1969 to 1975, he was Lecturer at [[University of Regensburg]] and from 1975 to 2009 a professor of Mathematics at [[University of Duisburg-Essen]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Curriculum vitae of Jürgen Herzog |url=http://doctorat.unibuc.ro/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/CV-J_Herzog.pdf |access-date=29 November 2022 |website=unibuc.ro}}</ref>

==Biography==
Herzog was born in [[Heidelberg]] on 21 December 1941 and raised in [[Eberbach (Baden)|Eberbach]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name="commalgobit" /> After military service in the German Army, he enrolled at the [[University of Kiel]] from 1963<ref name=":0" /> and began studying mathematics and physics. Herzog transferred to the [[University of Heidelberg]] in 1964, and completed his undergraduate studies there.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bruns |first1=Winfried |last2=Conca |first2=Aldo |last3=Welker |first3=Volkmar |last4=Yassemi |first4=Siamak |title=Preface: Special issue in honor of Jürgen Herzog on the occasion of his 70th birthday |journal=J. Commut. Algebra |date=2013 |volume=5 |issue=1 |pages=1–4 |doi=10.1216/JCA-2013-5-1-1}}</ref> He received his Ph.D. with a thesis titled, ''Generators and Relations of Abelian Semigroups and Semigroup Rings'' at [[Louisiana State University]] in 1969 under the supervision of {{ill|Ernst A. Kunz|de|Ernst Kunz (Mathematiker)}}.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=3192}}</ref> He completed his [[habilitation]] at the [[University of Regensburg]] in 1974.<ref name=":0" /> He was an expert in the field of [[commutative algebra]] and its interactions to other mathematical fields such as [[combinatorics]].<ref name="commalgobit" />

==Personal life==
Herzog died on 23 April 2024 in Germany, following a sudden heart attack.<ref name="udueobit">{{cite web |last=Kohlhaase |first=Jan |author-link=Jan Kohlhaase |title=Obituary on Prof. Dr. Jürgen Herzog |url=https://www.uni-due.de/mathematik/nachruf_herzog_engl |publisher=Universität Duisburg-Essen}}</ref><ref name="commalgobit">{{cite web|url=https://www.commalg.org/jurgen-herzog-1941-2024/|title= Jürgen Herzog (1941-2024) |last1=Bruns|first1=Wilfried|last2=Conca|first2=Aldo|website=Commalg.org}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* Bruns, Winfred, Herzog, Jürgen, (1993).  ''Cohen-Macaulay rings'', Cambridge studies in advanced mathematics 39, Cambridge University Press.
* Herzog, Jürgen, Hibi, Takayuki, (2011).  ''Monomial Ideals'', Graduate Text in Mathematics.
* Ene, Viviana, Herzog, Jürgen, (2012). ''Gröbner Bases in Commutative Algebra'', Graduate Studies in Mathematics, 130. American Mathematical Society, Providence, RI.
* Herzog, Jürgen, Hibi, Takayuki, Ohsugi, Hidefumi, (2018).  ''Binomial Ideals'', Springer Graduate Texts in Mathematics.
